services.name: Climbing Walls
services.desc: All top-rope belayers as well as lead belayers and lead climbers must pass a test given by a HAF staff member in order to be certified to climb at High Altitude Fitness. This test is pass or fail and is designed to make sure everyone climbing or belaying in the rock gym is actively demonstrating safe climbing. THE MINIMUM AGE FOR GETTING BELAY CERTIFIED OR USING ANY GYM EQUIPMENT IS 14 YEARS OLD. IF UNDER 14 THE ONLY ACCESS ALLOWED IS IN THE ROCK GYM WITH SUPERVISION OF AN ADULT AT ALL TIMES. THANK YOU. services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: High Altitude Truckee offers various summer camps at the Truckee, Ca location. Our rock climbing summer camps are from ages 5-14 years old with skills ranging from beginner to intermediate. Join us for a rocking summer camp experience. Climbers will develop confidence in themselves with rock climbing, build trust and problem solving skills and learn the ropes of sport climbing and bouldering. Beginner and intermediate climbers will learn to top rope and improve skills. Curriculum includes equipment care and use, safety procedures, climbers knots, belaying skills, lowering, and climbing, age appropriate arts and crafts.
